S.source: printed p. 680; entry 'pariuz'; sense 4; illustrates 'shau–pariuz'
S.FORM: shau-pariuz uan maca k-anun iza yanan painan um-paciq-an
S.PHON: ʃaupariuð uan maθa kanun iða janan painan umpaθiqan
S.FORM: shau-pariuz uan matha k-anun iza yanan painan um-pathiq-an
S.PHON: ʃaupariuð uan maθa kanun iða janan painan umpaθiqan
S.TRANSL: Turn your eyelid up in case you have a grain of dust under it

S.source: printed p. 680; entry 'pariuz'; sense 5; illustrates 'shau–pariuz–in'
S.FORM: nak a maca shau-pariuz-in maqa a riqaz-an ya mia-kuza
S.PHON: nak a maθa ʃaupariuðin maqa a riqaðan ja miakuða

S.PHON: nak a maθa ʃaupariuðin maqa a riqaðan ja miakuða
S.TRANSL: My eyelid is turned up in order to see if there is something (in the eye)

S.source: printed p. 680; entry 'pariuz'; sense 6; illustrates 'sh–m–au–pariuz'
S.TRANSL: He turned up his eyelid

S.source: printed p. 680; entry 'parmuz'; illustrates 'parmuz'; reading 1 of 2 of 'ata (tu) parmuz'
S.TRANSL: Don't dive!

S.source: printed p. 680; entry 'parmuz'; illustrates 'parmuz'; reading 2 of 2 of 'ata (tu) parmuz'
S.TRANSL: Don't dive!

S.source: printed p. 680; entry 'parmuz'; sense 2; illustrates 'marmu–rmuz'
S.FORM: haya wa caw ya m-ilu miarain marmu-rmuz, pa-riqaz sa suma mia-zay sa min-ania
S.PHON: haja wa θaw ja milu miarain marmurmuð pariqað sa suma miaðaj sa minania

S.PHON: haja βa θaw ja milu miarain marmurmuð pariqað sa suma miaðaj sa minania
S.TRANSL: When that person goes to bathe (in the lake) he dives a lot to show off his skill

S.source: printed p. 680; entry 'parmuz'; sense 3; illustrates 'marmuz'

S.source: printed p. 680; entry 'parmuz'; sense 4; illustrates 'm–in–armuz'
S.TRANSL: Were you diving?

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'parmuz' (opens on p. 680); sense 4; illustrates 'm–in–armuz'
S.TRANSL: You went to the water; were you diving?

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'parshian'; illustrates 'parshian'
S.FORM: azazak, ata u-suhúy wazaqan m-riqaz, parshian

S.PHON: aðaðak ata usuhuj βaðaqan mriqað parʃian

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'paru'; illustrates 'paru'

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'paru'; sense 4; illustrates 'paru–i'

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'paru'; sense 4; illustrates 'paru–i'; reading 1 of 2 of 'ata (tu) paru–i cicu'

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'paru'; sense 4; illustrates 'paru–i'; reading 2 of 2 of 'ata (tu) paru–i cicu'

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'paru'; sense 5; illustrates 'paru–paru'

S.PHON: jaku paruparu sa tatruquð maqa a mintaun a qrus

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'paru'; sense 6; illustrates 'p–in–aru'
S.TRANSL: Did you beat the dog?

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'paru'; sense 7; illustrates 'p–in–aru–an'

S.source: printed p. 681; entry 'paru'; sense 7; illustrates 'p–in–aru–an'

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; illustrates 'pasáy'
S.TRANSL: Use the machete to cut (it)

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; illustrates 'patsáy'
S.TRANSL: Use a gourd to scoop up the water

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; illustrates 'pasaháy'
S.TRANSL: He used his hand to eat

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; illustrates 'pasa'

S.PHON: pasahaj numa uhu smapuk iðahaj a rusaw

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; illustrates 'pasaháy'

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; illustrates 'pasahay'

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; sense 5; illustrates 'pasay–ik'

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; sense 5; illustrates 'pasay–ik'

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; sense 6; illustrates 'pasay–in'

S.source: printed p. 682; entry 'pasaháy'; sense 6; illustrates 'patsahay–in'

S.source: printed p. 683; entry 'pasasuqa'; illustrates 'pasasuqa'

ata tu muqmuq malhilhiq p-in-ash'uzu pi-sa saran, ma-qarman riqaz-an

S.source: printed p. 684; entry 'pasi'; illustrates 'pasi'

TRANSL.notes: Source note: as someone who brags a lot

S.TRANSL: Ignore him

S.source: printed p. 684; entry 'pasiz'; sense 2; bound root marked with bars; illustrates 'pasiz–i'

TRANSL.notes: Source note: after it has fallen apart

S.TRANSL: Don't put the hoe back together

S.source: printed p. 685; entry 'pashakadaw'; illustrates 'pashakadaw'
